content: Josuwa i tagaviyaviya thelauko laghɨye e Walaghɨta Jorɨdan valɨvaŋga i njanja i wogiya weŋgiya Isirel gharɨgharɨniye

Iyake i govambwara va ŋgoroŋga na thɨ giya Kenan thelauniyeko — Jorɨdan yalasiniyeko thɨ wogiya weŋgiya Isirel gharɨgharɨniye. Eliyesa iye ravowovowo, Josuwa Nan nariye na Isirel uu theyaworo na theghewo lenji randevivaŋgi, thɨ giya thelauko weŋgi Isirel gharɨgharɨniye.

Mbaŋa va thɨ giya ghamba yakuyaku weŋgi wabwi na wabwi, uu theghesiwo na uu Manase vaŋgothiye weŋgi, va thɨ duda varɨ na varɨko le govambwara thɨ vakatha ŋgoreiye, ŋgora Giya Loi vama i utu giyawe Mosese.

Mosese kaerova i giya ghamba yakuyaku weŋgi uu theghewo na uu reghava vaŋgothiye, Jorɨdan valɨvaŋga e boimako. (Josep orumburumbuye va uu theghewo: Manase na Ipɨreim.) Iyemaeŋge, Mosese mava i wogiya ghamba yakuyaku regha weŋgi uu Livai e valɨvaŋgako iyako. Ko vambe i vatomwe eŋge thiya yaku e ghembaghemba laghɨlaghɨye na umauma inanjiwe lenji thetheghanɨko lenji ghamba ghan nana.
Isirel gharɨgharɨniye va thɨ giya lenji thelauko e valɨvaŋgako iyako ŋgoreiye vara iyako, ŋgora Giya Loi vama i utu giya weya Mosese.
Josuwa i wogiya ghemba Hebron weya Keleb

Mbaŋa regha gharɨgharɨ vavana Juda e gha uu tɨne thɨ raka menawe Josuwa mbaŋa vamba inanji Gilgal e tɨne. Gharɨgharɨke thiyake regha, Keleb Jepune nariye na i mena uu Keni e tɨne, i dagewe Josuwa iŋa, “Kaero u ghareghare ŋgoroŋga Giya Loi va i dagewe Mosese, Loi le lolo, ghen na ghino kaiwanda mbaŋa va inanda Kades Beniya e tɨne.

Ghino wo theghathegha vama i wo ghwevarɨ mbaŋa Giya Loi le rakakaiwo, Mosese va i variyeŋgo Kades Beniya e tɨne ya raŋgi na ya mena ya ghewaŋa budakai ina e thelauke iyake tɨne. Mbaŋa ya njoghawe, ya wonjogha toto emunjoruwe amalaghɨniye budakai va ya thuwe e maraŋgu.
Ko iyemaeŋge wouneko va weiŋguyaŋgiko thɨ vakatha gharelaghɨlaghɨ laghɨye weŋgi gharɨgharɨko wolaghɨye. Iyemaeŋge, ghino ya vareminje moli Giya lo Loi.

Iya kaiwae Mosese i tholo na i dagera e ghino, iŋa, ‘Iya vara thelauna mendava vo loŋganawe nevole ghen na orumburumbu tha na tha lenji ghamba yakuyaku mbaŋake wolaghɨye, kaiwae mendava u ghambu na u vareminja Giya lo Loi e gharenɨna laghɨye.’”

“Wo u thuwe, noroke kaero theghathegha kaero ghwevarɨ na umbolima iko mbaŋa Giya Loi va i utu giya utuutuko iyako weya Mosese. Va e mbaŋako iyako Isirel gharɨgharɨniye vamba thɨ rakaraka loloŋga e vuruvuru vwatavwatae, na Giya Loi, ŋgoreiye va le dagerawe, i vakathaŋgo mbe e yawayawaliŋgu ghaghadɨ noroke. Wo u thuweŋgo noroke! Wo theghathegha kaero i wo ghwewa na umbolima (85)
na lo vurɨgheghe noroke mbe ŋgora vara Mosese vamba e yawayawaliye na i variyeŋgo ya mena gheke. Lo vurɨghegheke mbe valɨkaiwaŋgu eŋge ya wa gaithɨ kaiwae o ya vakathava the bigithan.

Iya kaiwae noroke mau vatomwe eŋge weŋgo vanautumake e ououniyeke iya Giya Loi va i dagerake weŋgo va e mbaŋako iyako. Kaerova wo utu giya e ghen gharɨgharɨ laghɨlaghɨye idanji Anak inanji gheko, na ghembaghembako ghanji gana mbe thɨ vurɨgheghe eŋge. Ko iyemaeŋge Giya Loi ne i thalavuŋgo na ya vagege raŋgiyaŋgi ŋgoreiya va iŋako.”
Josuwa i wogiyawe Keleb, Jepune nariye gha dagemwaewo na i wogiya ghambae idae Hebron na le ghamba yakuyaku.
Hebron mbe Keleb, Jepune rara Keni nariye orumburumbuye lenji ghamba yakuyaku vara, kaiwae va i vareminje na i ghambu Giya Loi, Isirel lenji Loi.
Hebron vambe idae Kiriyat Aba, iye va lolo laghɨye regha wabwi Anak e tɨne.
